User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the SpendWise application.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile photo (optional).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Account entity.

initialBalanceCents.description: The initial balance of the account in cents.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

type.description: The type of the category ('expense' or 'income').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the category was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

date.description: The effective date of the transaction.

tags.description: Optional array of tags associated with the transaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the transaction was created.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Represents a monthly budget goal for a specific category.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Budget entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the budget was created.

RecurringRule.title: RecurringRule
RecurringRule.description: Represents a rule for recurring transactions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RecurringRule entity.

frequency.description: The frequency of the recurring rule ('weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly').

dayOfMonth.description: The day of the month for monthly recurring rules (optional).

dayOfWeek.description: The day of the week for weekly recurring rules (optional).

nextRunAt.description: Timestamp indicating the next run time for the rule.

active.description: Indicates whether the recurring rule is active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the recurring rule was created.

InsightsCache.title: InsightsCache
InsightsCache.description: Represents a cache of generated spending insights.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InsightsCache entity.

period.description: The period for which the insights were generated (e.g., 'YYYY-MM', 'last_30_days').

summary.description: A summary of the spending insights.

bullets.description: An array of bullet points highlighting key insights.

metrics.description: A map of key metrics related to the insights (e.g., 'topCategory', 'spendTotalCents').

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the insights were generated.

ttlExpiresAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cache entry should expire.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure data isolation and security for each user, adhering to the principle of 'Authorization Independence' by denormalizing the `userId` into each document. This avoids the need for `get()` calls in security rules, simplifying the rules and making them more robust. The design uses hierarchical paths for user-owned data, making security rules efficient. Segregation is achieved by isolating user-specific data into dedicated collections (`/users/{userId}/...`).  QAPs are supported by ensuring all documents within a collection share the same security posture, making list operations secure.

Each collection isolates data per user, ensuring multi-tenancy. User-specific data is structured under `/users/{userId}` for core user information.  Other collections such as `accounts`, `categories`, `transactions`, `budgets`, `recurringRules`, and `insightsCache` are structured to include a `userId` field to guarantee data isolation and allow for efficient querying within a user's scope.  Indexes are recommended on `transactions` for `(userId, date desc)`, `(userId, categoryId, date desc)`, and `(userId, accountId, date desc)` to optimize dashboard queries and filtered views, preventing collection scans.

The `insightsCache` collection stores pre-computed insights for each user, period, and is designed to minimize the computational load for generating insights on demand. The `ttlExpiresAt` field is used to invalidate the cache after a specified period, ensuring the insights remain relatively up-to-date.
